map.截面积(mm²) = 试样宽度(mm) × 厚度(mm)；抗张强度(MPa) =: Cross-section area (mm²) = specimen width (mm) × thickness (mm); tensile strength (MPa) = breaking load (N) ÷ cross-section area (mm²) (1 N/mm² = 1 MPa); tear strength (N/mm) = tearing force (N) ÷ thickness (mm). Tensile grades: ≥20 MPa excellent, 15~20 good, 10~15 qualified, <10 poor.
map.试样宽 10 mm、厚 1.5 mm：截面积 = 15 mm²。断裂负荷 240: Specimen 10 mm wide and 1.5 mm thick: cross-section = 15 mm². A breaking load of 240 N → tensile strength = 240/15 = 16 MPa, rated 'good' and meeting most shoe upper requirements. A tearing force of 45 N → tear strength = 45/1.5 = 30 N/mm.
map.为什么抗张强度要除以截面积？: Why is tensile strength divided by the cross-section area?
map.断裂负荷是力，同样材质的厚试样需要更大的力才能拉断；除以截面积得到的强度（应力）: Breaking load is a force, and a thicker specimen of the same material needs more force to break; dividing by the cross-section area gives a strength (stress) that compares fairly across specimens of different thickness.
map.撕裂强度单位是 N/mm 怎么理解？: How should the N/mm unit of tear strength be understood?
map.它表示使已有裂口继续扩展所需的力与厚度的比值，反映皮革抵抗撕裂扩展的能力，单位长: It is the ratio of the force needed to extend an existing tear to the thickness, reflecting the leather's resistance to tear propagation; the greater the force borne per unit length, the better.
